name: Revavroom

abilities.name: Metal Transport
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active {Metal} Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavor:
Revavroom viciously threatens others with the
sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from
its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
